hud.quotaMetToast: Quota met. Every crack now is a bonus.
hud.ruptureToast: The tank ruptured. Pressure is draining.

end.wonCracks: Quota met. Then too many open cracks broke the tank. Management has noted your adequate performance.
end.wonOverflow: Quota met. Then the tank overfilled and burst. Management has noted your adequate performance.
end.lostCracks: Too many open cracks broke the tank before you met the quota. This will go on your record.
end.lostOverflow: The tank overfilled and burst before you met the quota. This will go on your record.
